subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access + trust connector provisioning
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@acmecare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo — SOC 2 Type II report & trust connector provisioning

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation with Rajiv and the infra team. Per our call, two quick asks to keep the security review moving:

1) Access to our SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter (we can provide a temporary attestation if you need a faster handoff).
2) Provisioning for our trust connector (read-only) so your security team can view evidence and artifact snapshots in our portal; this avoids sending large bundles over email.

I've attached a short inventory (soc2-access-inventory.xlsx) that lists the artifacts available in the portal and a bridge letter template we typically share. Aditya will send the invite link for the trust connector; it can be scoped to read-only and expires after 90 days unless you request extended access.

Next steps I propose:
- Elena/Rajiv: confirm whether your reviewers need the full Type II report or a temporary attestation first (timeline preference).
- Aditya: initiate the trust connector invite + share access scope and any vendor questionnaire we should complete.

Happy to hop on a short call with your security lead if that helps.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

----

From: Elena Torres <elena@acmecare.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acmecare.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — SOC 2 Type II report & trust connector provisioning

Jonas,

Thanks — helpful recap. Quick clarification from our side: our procurement team prefers to review the full Type II report but will accept a temporary attestation to unblock the initial legal review (contracts). Ideally we get the temporary attestation this week and the full report next week.

Also, can you confirm whether the trust connector supports SSO (we use Okta) and whether log-level timestamps in artifacts preserve UTC? Rajiv will validate on the technical side.

Can you also indicate the point of contact if we have questions while we review (security questionnaire responses, artifact clarifications)?

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of InfoSec
AcmeCare Health

----

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@acmecare.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acmecare.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — SOC 2 Type II report & trust connector provisioning

Hi Elena / Rajiv — looping in next steps and quick technical notes: 

- Temporary attestation: we can issue a 2–4 week interim attestation today. I will attach the interim PDF in the trust portal once you confirm.
- Full Type II: we plan to release the full report to approved reviewers next business day after we complete your access provisioning.
- Trust connector: supports SSO via SAML2 / Okta. We’ll send a SAML metadata file during provisioning. Connector access is read-only by default; artifact timestamps are stored in UTC and surfaced in the portal UI.

Action items I will do today:
- Send trust connector invite (one-time link) scoped to read-only and limited to 3 reviewers. Link: https://redwood.app/trust-connector/invite/RDW-ACM-2026-03
- Upload the interim attestation (if you confirm you want it) and the SOC 2 inventory sheet to the portal.
- Start a short vendor questionnaire (attached as redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx) with a completed baseline section so you can see answers. Please mark any questions you need expanded.

Point of contact: you can reach me directly for questionnaire clarifications and artifact questions — Aditya Rao (aditya@redwood.com). For platform provisioning / SSO specifics you can also include Jonas.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Elena / Rajiv —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Elena — please confirm you want the interim attestation and I’ll tell Aditya to upload it now. Once the trust connector invite is accepted we’ll give your team a 14-day window to review before we release the full Type II to named reviewers.

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with Rajiv to show the portal artifact types and how the UTC timestamps map to event logs. Proposed times: Mon 8/23 at 10:00am PT or Tue 8/24 at 2:00pm PT — let me know which works and I’ll calendar it.

Best,
